callout.text: Upcoming tab filled (8 Nov ~1 PM HKT): Into the Wild Mon 9–Fri 13 Nov (Crowned Sword Zacian + Crowned Shield Zamazenta 5★; Druddigon/Orthworm 3★; Raid Hours Zacian Mon 9 + Zamazenta Tue 10 6–7 PM) → GO Wild Area Global Sat 14 (Zekrom + White Kyurem) & Sun 15 (Reshiram + Black Kyurem) 10 AM–6 PM + Modern Jacket Machamp 3★ → Cresselia + Darkrai 5★ + Mega Banette Mon 16–Tue 24 Nov (Raid Hour Wed 18) → Deoxys (all 4 formes) 5★ + Mega Metagross Wed 25 Nov–Tue 1 Dec (Raid Hour Wed 25). Still LIVE tonight: Altered Giratina 5★ + Mega Sableye + ghosty 1★/3★ + Shadow Tornadus first window → Sun 8 Nov ~10 PM; Festival of Lights India saree/kurta 1★ → Sun 8 Nov 8 PM India. Shadow Tornadus longer package resumes Mon 16 Nov → Tue 1 Dec. Pruned ended Sep–Oct events.
